$emeaBannerTagline
$emeaOrgName
 
Dear $__recipient.name,

AWS Onboarding Could Not Be Completed

We regret to inform you that we were unable to complete the Rapid AWS Onboarding process. As a result, no active AWS source was created in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.

#if($sourceId) #end #if($adminAccountId) #end
Onboarding Summary
Source ID $sourceId
AWS Management Account $adminAccountId
Deployment Status ✕ Failed
#if($failureReason)

Failure Details

$failureReason

#end

Recommended Actions

Please verify your AWS configuration before retrying. Common failure causes include:

  • Delegation access request rejected or timed out in the AWS Management Account
  • CloudFormation StackSet creation or instance deployment failures
  • Insufficient AWS IAM administrator permissions or organization policy restrictions
  • Invalid deployment account ID or incorrect configuration values

For detailed deployment and onboarding status, including account-level success or failure details, sign in to your AWS account and review the AWS onboarding logs.

Best Regards,
The SailPoint Support Team
